title: CONNECT-IP HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT policy.
scope: This verification covers Extended CONNECT use, server Extended CONNECT setting policy, CONNECT method, `connect-ip` protocol token, proxy authority, non-empty path and scheme, URI Template-derived scheme/path values, malformed-request rejection, 2xx response validation, Capsule Protocol response requirements, and aborting failed proxying attempts.
preconditions: RFC 9484 URI Template expansion policy is implemented.
RFC 9484 request and tunnel setup policies are trace-owned.
expected_result: The focused CONNECT-IP request-policy tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9484 Extended CONNECT artifacts, generated triage reflects requirements 0053-0064 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9484 HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
